methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Amca is a robotics and manufacturing company at IPO stage, founded by Jai Malik and Eli Giovanetti, having raised $76.5M to date. The comparable universe consists of 11 peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private firms. Top private comparables include Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The sector contains only 11 comparable companies total, and filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers yields fewer than three datapoints—below the minimum threshold required for reliable median benchmarking. A median derived from all sector peers would obscure material differences in stage and capital efficiency across the peer set and produce a misleading anchor.

Given these constraints, traditional triangulation via peer multiples cannot be reliably executed. Alternative valuation methods—such as precedent transaction analysis, discounted cash flow analysis if forward financials are available, or venture capital method applied to exit scenarios—would be required to establish a credible range. The primary uncertainty is the absence of sufficient comparables at Amca's specific stage and maturity profile within the Robotics & Manufacturing sector. Resolution of valuation would benefit from either proprietary financial data on existing peers or widening the sector lens to adjacent automation and industrials categories.
